description_en: Modifies the configurations such as forwarding rules for a Layer 4 application under a specified site
description_zh: 修改指定站点下四层应用的转发规则等配置
name: UpdateTransportLayerApplication

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) API operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The Layer 4 application ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListTransportLayerApplications](~~ListTransportLayerApplications~~) API operation
parameters.help_zh: 四层应用ID，可通过调用[ListTransportLayerApplications](~~ListTransportLayerApplications~~)接口获取
parameters.name: application_id

fields.help_en:
The client IP address pass-through protocol. Valid values:
off: Do not pass through.
PPv1: PROXY protocol v1, which supports client IP address pass-through for the TCP protocol.
PPv2: PROXY protocol v2, which supports client IP address pass-through for the TCP and UDP protocols.
SPP: Simple Proxy Protocol, which supports client IP address pass-through for the UDP protocol
fields.help_zh:
客户端IP传递协议，支持：
off: 不传递。
PPv1: PROXY Protocol v1协议，支持TCP协议的客户端IP传递。
PPv2: PROXY Protocol v2协议，支持TCP和UDP协议的客户端IP传递。
SPP: Simple Proxy Protocol协议，支持UDP协议的客户端IP传递
fields.name: client_ip_pass_through_mode

fields.help_en:
The edge port. Valid values:

A single port, such as 80.
A port range, such as 81-85, which represents ports 81, 82, 83, 84, and 85.
A combination of ports and port ranges, separated by commas, such as 80,81-85,90, which represents ports 80, 81, 82, 83, 84, 85, and 90.
The edge ports within a single rule and the edge ports across multiple rules must not overlap
fields.help_zh:
边缘端口。支持：

单个端口，例如80。
端口范围，例如 81-85，代表端口 81、82、83、84、85。
端口和端口范围组合，端口、端口范围之间用逗号分隔，例如80,81-85,90，代表端口80、81、82、83、84、85、90。
单个规则的边缘端口以及多个规则之间的边缘端口不允许重叠
fields.name: edge_port

fields.help_en:
The protocol of the forwarding rule. Valid values:

TCP: TCP.
UDP: UDP
fields.help_zh:
转发规则协议，支持：

TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The specific value of the origin server
fields.name: source

fields.help_en:
The origin server port. Valid values:

A single port. If the origin server port is a single port, any valid combination of edge ports is supported.
A port range. The origin server port can be set to a port range only when the edge port is a port range, and the range size must be the same as that of the edge port. For example, if the edge port is 90-93, you cannot set the origin server port to 81-85 because the origin server port range is 5 and the edge port range is 3, which are inconsistent
fields.help_zh:
源站端口。支持：

单个端口，当源站端口为单个端口时，支持任意合法的边缘端口组合。
端口范围，仅当边缘端口为端口段时，源站端口才允许设置为端口范围且范围大小需要与边缘端口一致。例如边缘端口若为90-93，则不允许将源站端口设置为81-85，因为源站端口范围为5，边缘端口范围为3，两者不一致
fields.name: source_port

fields.help_en:
The origin server type. Valid values:
ip: IP address.
domain: Domain name.
OP: Origin IPAM pool.
LB: Load balancing
fields.help_zh:
源站类型，支持：
ip: IP。
domain: 域名。
OP: 源地址池。
LB: 负载均衡器
fields.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The list of forwarding rules. For rule details, all parameters except the comment are required for each rule
parameters.help_zh: 转发规则列表。规则详情。每一条规则，除备注外，其他参数为必填
parameters.name: rules

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the IP access rule. After this feature is enabled, the IP access rules in WAF take effect for the Layer 4 application. Valid values:

on: Enable.
off: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
IP访问规则开关，开启后，WAF中的 IP访问规则对四层应用生效。

on: 开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: ip_access_rule

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable IPv6. Valid values:

on: Enable.
off: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
Ipv6开关。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: ipv6

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable network access optimization for the Chinese mainland. Default value: off. Valid values:

on: Enable.
off: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启中国大陆网络接入优化，默认关闭。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: cross_border_optimization

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the static IP address feature. Default value: off. Valid values:

on: Enable.
off: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启固定IP，默认关闭。取值范围：

on: 开启。
off: 关闭
parameters.name: static_ip

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable connection keep-alive protection. Default value: off. Valid values:

on: Enable.
off: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启连接保持防护，默认关闭。取值范围：

on: 开启。
off: 关闭
parameters.name: keep_alive_protection
